ModMetaData.name: ProgressionLESS: Water
ModMetaData.author: Cruesoe
ModMetaData.description:
All the Progression goodness, less research.
Overhauls water research, so every well, pump, pipe and plumbing fixture has a place in the research tree.
The "LESS" is less research: Progression: Water adds up to 36 research projects depending on your mods. This fork groups them into at most 8, such as primitive hygiene, water supply and basic fixtures, and folds a few more into Dubs Bad Hygiene's own projects. Everything stays in the same era, and still needs the other research it did before.
Forked from Progression: Water by ferny. Huge thanks to ferny for the original mod and all the Progression work this builds on. Replaces the original; do not use both.
For a really good modpack, check out The Progression Modpack on the Steam Workshop.
